title: Voice in Masters' head behind Morton Hall at Ohio University

tellings.quote: I remember the exact moment standing behind Morton Hall at Ohio University there was this little voice in my head that said maybe we should explore it this way

plain: While standing behind Morton Hall at Ohio University, a researcher named Mike Masters heard a small voice in his head telling him to come at the question a new way. Masters, who argues that the aliens may be humans from the future, tells Michels: "there was this little voice in my head that said maybe we should explore it this way." He tells it as the moment his idea began.
